import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.feature_selection import f_classif
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Find features with significant association (p < 0.05)
    f_scores, p_values = f_classif(feats.x, feats.y)
    significant_features = [feats.ids[i] for i in range(len(feats.ids)) if p_values[i] < 0.05]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation > 0.6
    correlated_pairs = set()
    for i in range(len(feats.ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(feats.ids)):
            corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:,i], feats.x[:,j])[0,1]
            if abs(corr) >= 0.6:
                fid1, fid2 = feats.ids[i], feats.ids[j]
                correlated_pairs.add((min(fid1, fid2), max(fid1, fid2)))
    
    # Build a set of unique features after removing duplicates
    unique_features = set()
    for pair in correlated_pairs:
        # Keep the one with higher absolute effect size
        idx1 = feats.column(pair[0])
        idx2 = feats.column(pair[1])
        effect1 = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx1]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, idx1])
        effect2 = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx2]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, idx2])
        keep = pair[0] if abs(effect1) > abs(effect2) else pair[1]
        unique_features.add(keep)
    
    # Identify features that are not near-duplicates
    non_duplicate_features = [fid for fid in feats.ids if fid not in unique_features]
    
    # Check for interaction terms among top features
    best_interaction = None
    best_auc = 0
    
    # Only check top 20 features for efficiency
    top_features = non_duplicate_features[:20]
    
    for i in range(len(top_features)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(top_features)):
            fid1, fid2 = top_features[i], top_features[j]
            col1, col2 = feats.column(fid1), feats.column(fid2)
            
            # Create product term
            product = feats.x[:, col1] * feats.x[:, col2]
            
            # Fit logistic regression with intercept, product term, and original terms
            X = np.column_stack([feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2], product])
            model = LogisticRegression(fit_intercept=True, penalty='none', solver='lbfgs')
            model.fit(X, feats.y)
            
            # Predict probabilities
            probas = model.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
            
            # Calculate AUC
            auc = roc_auc_score(feats.y, probas)
            
            if auc > best_auc:
                best_auc = auc
                best_interaction = (fid1, fid2)
    
    # Return the result
    if best_interaction and best_auc > 0.55:
        drivers = (best_interaction[0], best_interaction[1])
        columns = (best_interaction[0], best_interaction[1])
        products = (best_interaction,)
        loadings = {best_interaction[0]: 1.0, best_interaction[1]: 1.0}
        return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
    
    # If no good interaction found, return empty design
    return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
